# Verify m3: toc_tokens with name, html, data-toc-label keys
from markdown.extensions.toc import striptags
import markdown

md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'attr_list'])
result = md.convert("# Foo & Bar {:data-toc-label='Custom & Label'}")
print("Result HTML:", result)
print("toc_tokens:", md.toc_tokens)

token = md.toc_tokens[0]
print(f"name: {token.get('name')!r}")
print(f"html: {token.get('html')!r}")
print(f"data-toc-label: {token.get('data-toc-label')!r}")
print(f"id: {token.get('id')!r}")

# Check the required assertions
assert 'name' in token, "Missing 'name' key"
assert 'html' in token, "Missing 'html' key"
assert 'data-toc-label' in token, "Missing 'data-toc-label' key"
assert token['name'] == 'Custom & Label', f"Expected 'Custom & Label', got {token['name']!r}"
assert token['data-toc-label'] == 'Custom & Label', f"Expected 'Custom & Label', got {token['data-toc-label']!r}"
assert 'custom-label' in token['id'], f"Expected 'custom-label' in id, got {token['id']!r}"
assert '&' in token['html'], f"Expected '&' in html, got {token['html']!r}"

print("m3 verified")
